value.definition: a file of TypeScript source holding tests

invariants.statement: A file whose name ends `test.ts` is of this purpose.
The ending sits here as prose until a purpose can state an ending as a property.

value.definition: a file of TypeScript source with markup, with tests

invariants.statement: A file whose name ends `test.tsx` is of this purpose.
A test written with markup is of this purpose rather than of `test-ts`.
